node.title: Re^3: How might one determine empty XML payload?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [vlturner],

XML::LibXML->load: specify location, string, or IO at ...

What does the code look like that is causing this error? Maybe $input_xml is undef ([doc://Data::Dumper]), or perhaps you wrote XML::LibXML->load_xml($input_xml) by accident?

Regards,
-- Hauke D
